mu_name_from: Ours: MU has no Orb of Power Slash. Its Power Slash was a weapon skill of the Magic Gladiator's blades -- WebZen's AT_SKILL_SWORD6, skill 56, in item.txt's skill column on the Dark Reign, Explosion and Rune Blades, the Sword Dancer and the Imperial Sword -- known while one was held. The name is the orbs' own pattern, as the Orb of Fire Slash's.
why_this_one:
The only way the Magic Gladiator learns Power Slash (docs/plans/mg-skills/power-slash.md). The user, 2026-10-24: "Power Slash has to be orb" -- learned for good off this, with any weapon but a staff, not known only while a blade is held. Group 12 number 28 is ours: 0-22, 25 and 27 are used on main while branch darklord's plan holds 23, 24 and 26.

Its drop level 75 is ours, past the Orb of Fire Slash's 60; 75,000 zen; it drops only: Hanzo sells the early orbs (sim/market.cpp), not this one.
mesh_note: No geometry of its own. Gem01.bmd through Gem05.bmd are byte-identical in MuMain's Data/Item -- one md5 across all five -- so every orb in MU is one model told apart by its row, and this names the one the pipeline has built.

stats.note: An orb has no damage roll and no hand: it is a Prize and nothing else, and the shape of the row is the elf orbs' own (Version075/Items/Orbs.cs:63-67) -- one cell, durability one, dropped by monsters.
stats.durability_note: One. One reading, as a scroll is.
stats.classes_from: Ours, as the orb is: the Magic Gladiator's alone, as its skill is (sim::skillFor) and as MU's blades that carried it were his.
stats.requires_note: What the character must BE to read it. Level 150 is ours (the user, 2026-10-24: "Power Slash has to be orb"): our orbs ask about twice their drop level -- Cyclone 72 at 36, Death Stab 120 at 60, Fire Slash 120 at 60 -- and this one drops at 75, between Fire Slash and his blades' tier. No strength and no energy: MU's skill asked neither, its blade's requirements were the gate. The same level is on the skill block below and on the skill's row (sim/skills.cpp needLevel) -- the three must agree.

skill.note: What the orb teaches. Read once and gone -- the durability of one is what 'used once' means on this row.
skill.name: Power Slash
skill.tells: Five waves fanned out from his blade, striking what stands in a widening wedge six tiles ahead of him as they reach it: the nearest five, and up to six more.
skill.tells_from: The skill's own line in sim/skills.cpp, kept letter for letter so the orb's tooltip and the skill's card cannot say different things about the same blow. MU never prints a line like this at all; it is ours, as it is on the elf's orbs.
skill.energy_from: None: MU's skill 56 asks no energy (WebZen skill.txt:63, OpenMU SkillsInitializer.cs:175).
skill.level_from: Ours: twice the orb's drop level, 150 at 75 (the user, 2026-10-24: "Power Slash has to be orb"). MU asked no level of the skill: the blade was the gate.
